newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KGHM builds Zaire copper-cobalt mine - paper.
newsitem.headline: Polish KGHM builds Zaire copper-cobalt mine - paper.

text.p: Poland's KGHM copper concern, to be privatised in June, is building a copper and cobalt quarry in the south of Zaire, the Gazeta Wyborcza daily quoted KGHM's deputy president for development Jerzy Dobrzanski as saying.

Dobrzanski told the paper KGHM had received a licence to exploit deposits in Zaire under an accord with the state-owned Gecamines firm when the country's outsted president Mobutu Sese Seko was still in power. The new authorities assured KGHM that deals with investors would be respected, he said.

"Work on constructing the quarry started at the beginning of this year, we have several people from KGHM working there now. They have to prepare the logistic background for people and equipment," Dobrzanski said.
He said setting up of the construction works cost some $10 million, but delined to give any further financial details.
Dobrzanski said the copper content in the ore from the Zairian deposits was above 4.5 percent against two percent in KGHM's Polish deposits.
